import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
# Values transcribed verbatim from the two analyses executed this iteration (outputs saved above).
ORG=["C. elegans","C. briggsae","H. sapiens","M. musculus","D. rerio","G. gallus","D. melanogaster",
"A. sinensis","A. mellifera","B. belcheri","C. reinhardtii","T. brucei","L. major","G. intestinalis","P. aleatoria"]
IDP=[100.0,87.9,42.0,45.1,42.2,45.7,36.1,36.0,40.4,42.5,37.5,39.4,43.7,30.0,40.9]
TAB=[list(x) for x in ["PKTSGYSF","PKSSGYSF","PRELGFNI","PRELGFHF","PREIGYNI","PRERGFHF","PQDLGFTF",
"PQELGFAL","PRNLGYSF","PRELGMYHF".replace("M",""),"PKEMSFSL","PQEFGHLL","PQTLGYQF","PHTSGDHF","VRELGYQF"]]
COLS=[70,71,72,96,97,171,223,225]
CARA=["G241","P242","G243","C269","L270","N311","H353","E355"]
CATNEED=[None,None,None,'C',None,None,'H','E']

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,7.6))
ax=fig.add_axes([0.13,0.40,0.52,0.52])
for i,row in enumerate(TAB):
    for j,aa in enumerate(row):
        need=CATNEED[j]
        if need is not None:
            col="#1a7f37" if aa==need else "#f2d0d0"
        else:
            col="#dde7f2" if aa==TAB[0][j] else "#f3f3f3"
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j,len(TAB)-1-i),1,1,facecolor=col,edgecolor="white",lw=1.4))
        ax.text(j+.5,len(TAB)-1-i+.5,aa,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10,
                color="white" if col=="#1a7f37" else "#222",
                fontweight="bold" if need is not None else "normal")
ax.set_xlim(0,8); ax.set_ylim(0,15)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(8)+.5)
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{c}\n({r})" for c,r in zip(COLS,CARA)],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(15)+.5); ax.set_yticklabels(ORG[::-1],fontsize=9,style="italic")
ax.tick_params(length=0)
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_xlabel("OSM-6 position (structurally equivalent E. coli CarA residue)",fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_title("A  Residue identity at anchored GATase1 catalytic positions, 15 IFT52 orthologs\n"
             "green = catalytic residue retained, pink = substituted",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
axb=fig.add_axes([0.665,0.40,0.075,0.52]); axb.barh(np.arange(15),IDP[::-1],color="#7a9cc6")
axb.set_ylim(-.5,14.5); axb.set_yticks([]); axb.set_xlim(0,100); axb.set_xlabel("% id to OSM-6",fontsize=8.5)
axb.tick_params(labelsize=8)
for s in ("top","right"): axb.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: structural-transfer deviation at the 11 CarA reference positions
POS=[241,242,243,269,270,273,311,313,314,353,355]
LBL=["G241","P242","G243","C269","L270","Q273","N311","G313","F314","H353","E355"]
D={"GuaA (true GATase, control)":[1.01,0.43,1.80,0.70,0.73,0.87,2.32,1.37,1.27,0.88,1.26],
   "crIFT52 (5FMR)":[4.33,4.63,np.nan,2.36,5.51,7.32,1.77,np.nan,4.91,3.64,1.49],
   "mmIFT52 (5FMS)":[4.02,4.55,8.08,2.90,5.48,6.60,1.82,np.nan,4.93,3.31,1.69],
   "ceOSM-6 (AF)":[4.11,4.07,7.25,1.94,5.57,6.00,1.72,np.nan,5.29,3.39,1.69],
   "hsIFT52 (AF)":[3.96,4.53,7.89,2.43,5.79,6.14,2.00,np.nan,5.24,3.52,1.45]}
ax2=fig.add_axes([0.08,0.07,0.86,0.235])
cols=["#1a7f37","#c44","#d4722a","#8a4fc0","#2b6ca3"]; w=0.17
for k,(lab,v) in enumerate(D.items()):
    x=np.arange(11)+(k-2)*w
    ax2.bar(x,np.nan_to_num(v,nan=0),w,color=cols[k],label=lab)
    for xi,vi in zip(x,v):
        if np.isnan(vi): ax2.text(xi,0.25,"gap",ha="center",fontsize=6.5,rotation=90,color="#666")
ax2.axhline(2.0,ls="--",c="#555",lw=1)
ax2.text(10.6,2.2,"2 A",fontsize=8,color="#555",ha="right")
ax2.set_xticks(np.arange(11)); ax2.set_xticklabels(LBL,fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel("C-alpha deviation\nafter TM-align (A)",fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel("E. coli CarA reference position (1JDB chain C)",fontsize=9.5)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=5,frameon=False,loc="upper center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,1.30))
for s in ("top","right"): ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax2.set_title("B  Structural transfer of CarA catalytic, oxyanion and pocket positions onto IFT52 GIFT domains",
              fontsize=10.5,loc="left",pad=26)
plt.show()

print("Catalytic-position retention across 15 orthologs:")
for j,(c,r,n) in enumerate(zip(COLS,CARA,CATNEED)):
    if n is None: continue
    k=sum(1 for row in TAB if row[j]==n)
    print(f"  {r} ({n}) retained in {k}/15 orthologs")
print("\nOxyanion strand CarA G241-P242-G243:")
for j in (0,1,2):
    print(f"  CarA {CARA[j]} -> {sorted(set(r[j] for r in TAB))}  (Gly retained in {sum(1 for r in TAB if r[j]=='G')}/15)")
